Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet on genuine transparent background. Reference image is the approved Dante Skitter enemy. Preserve exactly its original creature identity, slate-green segmented organic carapace, long articulated legs, amber seams, head and appendages, hand-painted shaded game-asset look.
Create an animation atlas with EXACTLY EIGHT cells in a regular FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid, wide canvas 2:1 aspect ratio, all equal square cells, NO labels or gridlines. One complete creature per cell, same size/camera/right-facing grounded orientation, feet on same baseline at 82 percent of each cell height, torso pivot at center. Comfortable transparent padding in each cell, absolutely no cropping/overlap.
Read row major: cell0 neutral idle; cell1 walking legs stride A; cell2 walking passing/contact B; cell3 walking opposite stride C; cell4 walking passing/contact D; cell5 crouched anticipation with legs braced; cell6 forward attack extension with planted supporting legs; cell7 compressed hit recoil. Real anatomical leg pose changes, alternating supporting feet and bent joints, not rotations of one drawing. Torso stable, never roll whole creature upside down. Keep same 3/4 top-down game view as reference. No environment, no background, no ground shadow (runtime adds contact shadow), no text, no extra creatures. Accurate eight-frame sprite atlas, organic sci-fi illustrated, not pixel art and not polygon low-poly.
